content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target), confidence 0.72.**

- **Customer side is already at/above fallback.** Section 14 (p0079) lets Client terminate at will on written notice, with services and fees running only to the last day of the following month, and no early-termination fee or penalty anywhere in the document (fees are invoiced monthly in arrears under Section 5, so the absent pro-rata refund of prepaid fees is a preferred-position nicety only, noted rather than flagged).
- **Vendor side fails the fallback.** TrueLink's only convenience exit is non-renewal at the end of each one-year term (p0078), but on only thirty (30) days' notice — below the 90-day floor and within walk-away territory.
- **Smallest cure:** one replace in p0078 splitting the mutual notice so TrueLink must give ninety (90) days while our 30-day notice is preserved (no reduction of a right that benefits us; no dangling references created). Redline validated `ok:true` with the minimality gate passing.
